name: Old Maid
description: Take one hidden card from the next player, then discard any matching rank pair. Shed all your cards; the player left holding the unmatched queen loses.
rules: Take one hidden card from the next player, then discard any matching rank pair. Shed all your cards; the player left holding the unmatched queen loses.
ui_instructions: Tap a face-down card beside an opponent’s name to draw it. Matching ranks are removed automatically; your hand stays face up only for you.

tutorial.html:
Old Maid

Take one hidden card from the next player, then discard any matching rank pair. Shed all your cards; the player left holding the unmatched queen loses.
